description: This file defines data structures and methods related to tracing spans in OpenTelemetry, including Span, SpanEvent, SpanLink, and associated JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: Span
classes.description: Represents a single operation performed by a component, including trace identifiers, timing, attributes, events, links, and status.

classes.name: SpanEvent
classes.description: A timestamped annotation with a name and attributes, representing an event within a span.

classes.name: SpanLink
classes.description: A reference from one span to another, possibly in a different trace, with associated attributes and flags.

classes.name: SpanFlags
classes.description: Constants used to interpret the span's flags field, representing trace flags and remote status bits.

classes.name: SpanKind
classes.description: Enumeration of span types, such as internal, server, client, producer, and consumer.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Encodes the span or span event into OTLP JSON format.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Decodes OTLP JSON data into the span or span event structure.
